compiler_only_output.reason: include/types.h gives Vector3 a deliberately empty inline destructor, so every TU that destroys a Vector3 re-emits it as vague linkage -- here the Vector3 automatics in State7 (the position passed to Player::Hurt, and the cylinder offset handed to dCcAcPos_c::SetPosRelativeToActor), in State2 (the two vectors it builds toward the chased player) and in State0 (the spawn position) pull it in. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, owned by src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp; this object's copy is the identical 4-byte `bx lr` body and no surviving section here references it. deadstrip-duplicate makes rombuild compare this body against those cartridge bytes before dropping it; plain deadstrip is the one disposition never compared against the cartridge.

Homeless. ~daBtfly_c is declared in include/daBtfly_c.h and written out of line in this TU, so mwcc emits three variants -- under the file-global `#pragma defer_codegen off` this TU carries, in the ROM-ascending source order D1, D0, D2 -- but the cartridge carries only D1 (ov100:0x02140d80, 0x58) and D0 (ov100:0x02140dd8, 0x6c), which are exactly the two destructor slots of _ZTV9daBtfly_c. No address anywhere in config/ names a D2 for this class: config/arm9/overlays/ov100/symbols.txt has no such row and a search of every module symbol file finds none, so tubuild.all_symbol_homes() returns no home for it.
